newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan Taleban punish beard trimmers - radio.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban punish beard trimmers - radio.

text.p: Authorities of Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic movement on Saturday punished 75 men found trimming their beards in the capital Kabul, state-run Kabul radio said.

The broadcast, monitored in Islamabad, said the mobile units of the Department for Promoting Virtue and Preventing Vice meted out "suitable punishment" to the men for violating orders against beard-trimming. It gave no details of the action taken.

Soon after taking Kabul last September, the Taleban said it was an obligation of all Moslem men to grow a beard. On Wednesday they warned they would start punishing men caught trimming their facial hair.
